contexts.text: Nothing exists in the universe which is not under some general, in order that it may exist and subsist.
It can never be but that a Church shall exist somewhere on the earth.
It has been provided that such a man shall never exist again...
This is the order of the existence of all things.

Each and all things come forth and subsist from the Lord; and from the union of His human essence with the Divine one; and from the conjunction of both... with His Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth.
Nothing ever exists before the sight of the Angels which is not representative...
Such combats never exist before...

The reason that each and all things are representative, is that they have come forth, and continually come forth, that is, subsist, from the influx of the Lord through Heaven; (like) the human body, which comes forth and subsists through its soul; and therefore each and all things in the body are representatives of its soul.
By genuine visions are meant visions... of those things which really exist in the other life.
When this sight is opened... the things which actually exist with Spirits are seen...
Under Be, see this reference. [Potts: This is the first of some important extracts.]
Born to (Abraham) = to come forth from the Divine.
(Thus) the Lord's Divine Human came forth from the Divine Itself. Treated of.
That which is unconnected does not come forth.
A free state of deliberation... exists every moment while man is being reformed and regenerated.
The eternal is the infinite as to manifesting.
Unless what is lower exists from interior things, as an effect from its own efficient cause, it does not exist.
It is a general rule, that nothing can come forth and subsist from itself, but from, that is, through another thing.
Isaac sent Jacob = the beginning of the manifestation... of the Lord's Divine Natural.
He sent him to Padan Aram = the beginning of the manifestation by means of the Knowledges of that good.
It is the reception of life of which manifesting is predicated.

Manifesting is predicated of the Lord also, but only while He was in the world; and He there put on the Divine being. But when He became the Divine being, manifesting could no longer be predicated of Him otherwise than as something proceeding from Him. That which proceeds from Him is that which appears as manifesting in Him; whereas it is not in Him, but is from Him, and causes that men, Spirits and Angels come forth, that is, live. To come forth, with man, Spirit, and Angel, is to live...

(Thus) before the organic forms of the body came forth, there was use... Use flows in from the Lord, through Heaven, according to the order and form according to which Heaven is ordered by the Lord, thus according to correspondences: thus man comes forth, and thus he subsists.

There does not exist anything in the nature of things which does not come forth and subsist from other things. That which comes forth and subsists from other things is called a general; and the things of which it consists and subsists are called particulars.
Corporeal things have come forth and have subsisted from the things which are of his spirit...

As each and all things which are in the world come forth and perpetually come forth, that is, subsist, from things prior to themselves, it follows that they come forth and subsist from a world which is above nature... And as there must be a continual connection with that World in order that they may subsist or perpetually come forth, it follows that the purer or more interior things which are in nature, and consequently which are in man, are from thence...

The Lord's Divine Human is the Divine manifesting from Divine being... and He Himself is Divine being; for Divine being and Divine manifesting are one. Signified. For the Divine manifesting is the Divine Itself proceeding from Divine being; and is in image a man...

For without influx through Heaven, by which it becomes the Divine manifesting, Divine being could not have been communicated to any Angel... That as to the Divine Itself the Lord is Divine being, and as to the Divine Human Divine manifesting, see AC 4687. The Lord's Human itself could not receive any influx from Divine being, unless the Human in Him had been made Divine; for that must be Divine which receives Divine being. (Thus) the Divine truth does not proceed immediately from the Divine Itself, but from the Lord's Divine Human.
For form = the essence of a thing; and aspect = the manifestation thence; and as good is the essence itself, and truth is the manifestation thence...

It is a fallacy of merely natural sense, that from the first creation there has been impressed on seeds the quality of growing into trees and flowers, and of prolificating themselves, and that thence is all coming forth and subsistence. And if they are told that nothing is able to subsist unless it continually comes forth, according to the canon, that subsistence is a perpetual coming forth; and also that everything which is unconnected with what is prior to itself falls into nothing, the Sensuous of the body... does not apprehend it; nor that each and all things subsist just as they have come forth, by influx from the Spiritual World, that is, through the Spiritual World from the Divine.
It is the Divine truth, which proceeds from the Divine good, that is, from the Lord, from which all things have come forth and do come forth... AC 6880:end.

Whatever in universal nature has no correspondence with the Spiritual World does not come forth; it has no cause from which it may come forth, consequently from which it may subsist... Effects cannot subsist unless the cause is constantly in them.

So is it with the cause relatively to the end; unless this cause also comes forth from its cause, which is the end, it is not a cause... Hence it is evident, that as each and all things in the world have come forth from the Divine, so they do come forth from the Divine.

Influx is circumstanced as are coming forth and subsistence; nothing comes forth from itself, but from what is prior to itself, thus at last from the first; that is, from being and manifesting from itself. It is also evident that all things subsist from the Same; for subsistence is circumstanced in the same way as coming forth; because to subsist is to perpetually come forth. HH 9. DLW 303.
The gathering or manifestation of spiritual good in the goods and truths of the Natural. Treated of.
That which is called fortune, is from the influx of Providence into the ultimates of order, where it so comes forth.
See End.
The ideas of space come forth from measurement by times.
The Natural comes forth through the Spiritual.
All evils come forth from (these loves)... All goods come forth from (these loves); and as all goods, so do all truths come forth thence.
From the presence (of Heaven), there is the manifestation of such things with the evil. Signified.
Evil is not from the Lord; but it comes forth from man...
All haste comes forth from some affection that has been excited.

The evils which are there all come forth through influx from the Hells... and they come forth according to the state of the evil in which are the Spirits who are being vastated; and the state of evil comes forth according to the privation of good and truth.
The purification of truth from falsity in man can never exist without fermentation... But after this combat has come forth...
Horror comes forth from the mere influx of falsity and evil with those who have conscience.
The anxieties which then come forth... They come forth from the hurting of the natural life.
Whatever comes forth in the natural world, derives its origin and cause from those things which come forth in the Spiritual World.
The Angels (can see) all things which come forth (in the Hells).
As these things involve those which come forth in the Societies in Heaven... AC 8472.
All there communicate with each one; hence comes forth the good of all in general...
Each and all things in universal nature come forth from interior things in their order...
The truths of good are truths which are from good, and in themselves are goods; because they derive their manifesting from good.
The correspondence of such things as come forth in the natural world with those which are in the Spiritual World.
That which is inmost reigns universally in the things which are round about... for thence is the essential of the manifestation of all things.

The case is the same with sight as it is with every thing which comes forth, that nothing comes forth from itself, but from what is prior to or higher than itself, thus at last from the First or Highest...
Nothing comes forth in Heaven except from (good conjoined with truth).
Faith comes forth from (the good of charity).
This comes forth from (the following circumstance).

The reason words = truths, is that in the Original Language word = that which is something, and that which really exists. Hence it also = truth; for everything which really exists from being has relation to truth.

The works of the six days, and the rest on the seventh = the things which come forth with man in the first and second states of his regeneration; and also those which come forth with him when he is regenerate.
Attends not to the deeds, but to the will, from which, through which, and for the sake of which, the deeds come forth.
For the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord is that reality through which all things have come forth, and through which all things subsist.
All falsity which injures... derives its manifesting from evil; for falsity from evil is evil appearing in a form.

Nothing comes forth from itself, but from what is prior to itself; so also is it with truth and good. That from which anything comes forth is internal; and that which comes forth is the external of it. Each and all things which come forth are circumstanced as are cause and effect; no effect can come forth without an efficient cause... They are also circumstanced as are endeavour and motion; no motion can come forth without endeavour... (And so again) no action can come forth without will... From these things it is evident, that in each and all things there must be an internal, in order that they may come forth, and that they may afterwards subsist...
The manifestation of the inmost Heaven within that uniting medium. Signified.
In carrying it = manifestation and subsistence. (For) to carry = to hold together in a state of good and truth, thus to come forth and subsist.
Here to make = that it may come forth; to carry = that it may subsist; and to bear = that it may perpetually come forth.
For the Heavens come forth from Him...

Manifestation and subsistence from good. Signified... (For) to be encompassed with sockets of gold = to be continued from good, and to derive manifestation; and as it = to derive manifestation, it = to derive subsistence; for that from which anything comes forth it also subsists by; for subsistence is a perpetual coming forth.
Everything which really comes forth, and which is anything, is from Divine truth. Signified.

From (the Divine truth which proceeds from the Divine Good of the Divine love of His Divine Human) the Heavens have come forth; and from it they perpetually come forth, that is, subsist; or, what is the same, from it the Heavens have been created, and from it they are perpetually being created, that is, preserved; for preservation is perpetual creation, as subsistence is perpetual coming forth.
God = the Divine manifesting; and the Divine manifesting is the Divine of faith, thus the Divine truth; for all truth comes forth from good; for truth is the form of good.
For the things which come forth in the world are images of the things in the Heavens; because everything natural comes forth from what is spiritual; that is, from the Divine in the Heavens.
Afterwards a New Heaven with a new earth will come into existence.

Therefore whatever in the natural world comes forth from the Spiritual World is called a correspondent. It is to be known that the natural world comes forth from the Spiritual World, precisely as an effect does from its efficient cause.
That all things which are in the world come forth from the Divine...
These take place successively and come forth simultaneously in such admirable order...

From this origin are all things which come forth and appear in the Heavens... The reason the Lord in Heaven appears as a Sun, is that it is the Divine love from which all spiritual things come forth; and, by means of the sun of the world, all natural things. HH 172.

The things which come forth in the Heavens, do not come forth in a similar way to those on earth; in the Heavens all things come forth from the Lord according to correspondences with the interiors of the Angels...
Because they correspond, they really come forth.
For they place the existence of every thing in what is material.
Marriage love derives its existence from innocence...

Divine peace is in the Lord, coming forth from the union of the Divine Itself and the Divine Human in Him. The Divine of peace in Heaven is from the Lord, coming forth from His conjunction with the Angels...
When there comes forth with him the conjunction of good and truth...

As the learned have thus thought, they have seen and said, that subsistence is a perpetual coming forth; thus that as all things have come forth from the First, they also perpetually do come forth, that is, subsist.
How great a multitude of Angels, from the first creation to the present time, has come into existence from (little children who die).
Whatever comes forth interiorly in man, comes forth in forms which are substances; for that which does not come forth in substances as subjects, is nothing.
The varieties of the duration (of the stay in the World of Spirits) come forth from...
Unless (thought and perception) were in and from substances... they would not come forth at all.
The things inscribed on the memory from the will and its thought, are... inscribed on the whole man, and there exist in order according to the order of the parts of the body.
Without terminations, (the will and thought) are as things unterminated, which do not as yet exist, thus which are not as yet in the man.
Such a thing cannot exist in the world.
Such things as are in the Heavens, which come forth from the Sun...
From this habit it comes forth, that man scarcely knows his interiors.
This comes forth in the Spiritual World from the fact...
Natural heat which comes forth from the sun...

He who believes that anything comes forth in the natural world without the influx of the Spiritual World, is mistaken; for what is natural does not come forth and subsist except from what is spiritual...
Without equilibrium in them nothing comes forth and subsists.
All coming forth or effect takes place in equilibrium...
Spiritual equilibrium or freedom comes forth and subsists between good acting... and evil reacting...
They who maintain that... without the Word man can know the existence of God, and of Heaven and Hell...
God is a Man, and thereby he is a God coming forth; not coming forth from Himself, but in Himself. He who comes forth in Himself is the God from whom all things are.
Each and all things of the vegetable kingdom... come forth from seed.

The Sun of the Spiritual World in its essence is such, that spiritual heat and light can come forth from it; and the sun of the natural world in its essence is such, that natural heat can come forth from it.
Whether such things come forth from eggs...
Worms come forth in seeds, kernels, etc.
Nothing exists which does not come forth thence...
The perfection of every form comes forth from various things suitably placed in their order.
Infestation does not exist in the natural world...
The spiritual state in which manifestly appear those things which exist in Heaven.
Because he does not know that all things which come forth in the Spiritual World are correspondences; and that all things which come forth in the natural world derive thence their spiritual origin.
As this comes forth below from the multiplication of evils...
Are not external things for the sake of internal ones, that they may cease in them, and subsist in them, and thus come forth...
The Church will expire unless a new one comes forth...
This (evangelization) will come forth after the Last Judgment...
It is certain that the New Church... will come forth...
The delight of use derives its essence from love, and its manifestation from wisdom.
Love manifests itself; nay, it comes forth and lives, by means of these delights.

The preservation of the whole is nothing but the perpetual influx of Divine good and Divine truth into forms created by themselves; for thus subsistence or preservation is a perpetual coming forth or creation.
These things cannot but come forth from the Divine wisdom...
That the chastity of marriage comes forth by means of a total renunciation of whoredoms from religion.
What is natural derives its origin from what is spiritual; and in its coming forth is nothing but a congeries of spiritual things gathered together...
This comes forth on account of the difference between what is spiritual and what is natural. CL 328.
From the singulars, the universal exists and consists.
If the devil actually exists...
The two Angels asked, How could evil come forth, when nothing but good had come forth from creation? In order for anything to come forth, it must have an origin...
That the Spiritual World has come forth and subsists from its own Sun; and the natural world from its. ISB 9.
Subsistence demonstrates coming forth; and therefore it is said that subsistence is a perpetual coming forth...
As perpetual subsistence is thence... coining forth is also thence; for to perpetually subsist is perpetually to come forth as it has come forth.

Nothing comes forth from an active alone, nor from a passive alone... (Thus) whatever in this solar world has come forth from the beginning, and afterwards comes forth every moment, is from what is spiritual through what is natural.
A plurality of Gods... arose solely from...
In order that uses may come forth...
Love and wisdom really come forth...
Faith, as to its manifestation with man, is spiritual sight.
Under Essence, see this reference.
This (second) Advent of the Lord exists in order...
1.2. Do not believe in the existence of Spirits.
They suppose that they know the causes of all things, and are thus persuaded of existence.
That such things exist...
On the coming forth and subsistence of human bodies from the Lord through the Grand Man.
Why Spirits do not... instruct men concerning the existence and quality of Spirits.
That natural things come forth from spiritual ones.
Acts... come forth from the thought...
(The absurdity) that God came forth together with the world.
Thou hast created all things = that from Him is all coming forth and life... not natural coming forth and life, but spiritual coming forth and life.
The reason to create = to come forth, is that those alone are said to come forth who have been reformed...
Winds come forth in the Spiritual World also... and they come forth to the lower parts of the earth there.
The good of life is the effect, in which the prior causes come forth; which do not come forth unless there is an effect in which they may come forth and subsist.
All goods derive their existence from celestial and spiritual love; and all evils derive their existence from the loves of self and of the world...
To be to him as the dew = its spiritual coming forth and rebirth.
To fall = to disappear, thus not to exist.
The coming forth of faith from charity. Treated of.
Concerning the coming forth of charity and of faith with man, it may be said, that each comes forth at the same moment; for although charity produces faith...
Love, in its essence is to will; and in its manifestation is to do.
Neither faith nor charity exists with man, until they come forth actually; and they come forth actually in works.
The affections of good and truth... cannot but come forth in act; and when they come forth they are called uses. AE 831:4.
That these two thoughts exist, everyone... may see.
The Divine Itself of the Lord, from which His Human came forth...
The Heavens... are not permanent, like the lands of our Earth; but come forth in a moment entirely according to the reception of Divine truth by the Angels... AE 926:2.
Nothing can come forth in thought, unless it is from some affection...
It thus comes to pass that...
Jehovah, as to His being, is Divine love; and as to His manifesting, is Divine good united to Divine truth.
The Only-begotten of the Father = the coming forth or proceeding from the Divine being in Him.

One Divine by itself is not possible, but there must be a trine: this trine consists of being, manifesting and proceeding. Being must by all means come forth; and when it comes forth it proceeds... (Thus) the being of an Angel is that which is called his soul; his manifesting is that which is called the body; and the proceeding from both is that which is called the sphere of his life. Without the latter, an Angel neither comes forth, nor exists.

The Divine called the Father is Divine being; the Divine Human called the Son is the Divine manifesting from that being; and the Divine called the Holy Spirit is the Divine proceeding from the Divine manifesting and from the Divine being. AE 1116:3. AE 1116:4.
As Is is not Is, unless it comes forth, being and manifesting, in God, are one; for while He Is, He comes forth; and while He comes forth, He Is.
One thing comes forth from another progressively even in the natural world; but this through causes from the Spiritual World...
That from the Spiritual, through these forces, there come forth plants, and also animals; both those which appear in Heaven, and those which are in the world.
They come forth according to the states of the Angels...
In the Spiritual World, earths come forth in a moment... DLove 12:3.
Aristotle, Cicero, and others, have written concerning the existence of God...
To will and not to act is not possible, because it does not come forth...
In order that these faculties may come forth in effect and in use, they have been made of created substances and matters...
4. As natural things have come forth from spiritual things they are correspondences...
2. (The will and the understanding) come forth actually...
The existence and permanence of (the thoughts and affections) is memory; and the reproduction of them is reminiscence.
9. Love comes forth in use.
7a. Therefore, when the Lord's Divine love comes forth with man in charity... His Divine wisdom comes forth with man in faith...
That the Lord... animates all things in Heaven and the world... some to live, and some to be and come forth.
3. The presence of this Sun also comes forth by means of heat and light...
5. By animation is meant not only that they live, but also that they are, and come forth...
2. Rose gardens and greeneries which come forth new every morning...
3. From the human race as a seminary, the... Angels come forth.
But a full idea of the creation or of the coming forth of all things in their order from life... cannot be given...
God 3. 2. As God is and comes forth in Himself, and as all things in the world are and come forth from Him, He is infinite.
God. 4. 11. See Create.
Redeemer 1. 8. Good comes forth by means of truth, consequently, truth is the form of good.
Redeemer. 3. 2. Everything which comes forth and goes forth from the mouth of God...
Trinity. 1. 4. The trinity of God did not come forth actually until...
Trinity. 10. Unless a New Church comes into existence...
